notes.title: Visual Novel Fest Announcement & February Version Update
notes.content:
"Mound of Music" will participate in Steam’s Visual Novel Fest (March 4–11). All players interested in music and its cultural significance are invited to experience the game, which will be available at a significant discount during the fest.

Additionally, the game has been updated to version v.250225. The main updates are as follows:

[list]
[*] Add a new track New Track "Por Una Cabeza", featuring three levels of difficulty. Simply switch music modes to unlock it directly.
[*] MIDI-to-Music Conversion Tool: Convert MIDI files more easily and import them into the game. Download the tool via the Elif Games official website:
https://elifgames.fun/contents/moundofmusic/index.html

[*] Bug Fixes: Resolved memory anomalies in original tracks.
[*] Fix other non-critical bugs and perform optimizations.
[/list]

The game content will continue to be improved and enriched.
We appreciate your support, please consider leaving a positive review for "Mound of Music."
If you have any questions, please join our discord to get in touch with the developer.

Elif Games

notes.title: December Version Update: Greensleeves
notes.content:
"Mound of Music" has been updated to version v.241105. The main updates are as follows:

1. Added a new track "Greensleeves," featuring four levels of difficulty. Simply switch music modes to unlock it directly.
2. Added a display and collection feature for rewards achieved by clearing the highest difficulty level without missing any notes in the music gameplay.
3. Removed restrictions on the "Devil's Deal" option in music mode.
4. After switching modes, you will be directly taken to the corresponding scene.
5. Updated the instructions for original track audio files, specifying that the sampling rate must be set to 44100Hz, and it is recommended that the cover image size does not exceed 1MB.
6. Corrected errors related to the recording files of original tracks.
7. Fixed potential errors that may occur when clicking the pause button after a track has finished playing.
8. Fix other non-critical bugs and perform optimizations.

The game content will continue to be improved and enriched.
We appreciate your support, please consider leaving a positive review for "Mound of Music."
Recently, the Workshop has added some new tracks, and everyone is welcome to enjoy the works of other players or create their own favorite tracks!
If you have any questions, please join our discord to get in touch with the developer.

Elif Games

notes.title: "Mound of Music" is launching today, let's fall in love with music together!
notes.content:
The twelve-key music game "Mound of Music" that simulates real instrument playing is finally here today, thanks to everyone's support!
This is Elif Games' first game, a personal independent game that the producer has dedicated nearly two years of full-time work to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984583/6557a8cc9dbe3bff6bf55edb49232662fde03d0d.png[/img]
The birth of the game: 30,000 hours of accumulation, 3,000 hours of development, 300 hours of debugging, all for 3 hours of gameplay experience.
30,000 hours of accumulation: The producer has been working full-time in game development for over a decade, accumulating more than 30,000 hours of experience in game development.
3,000 hours of development: The game has been in development for nearly two years, and even counting the work hours of just one person, it has long exceeded 3,000 hours.
300 hours of debugging: The game play time recorded on Steam includes only the debugging time of related modules, and even so, it has exceeded 300 hours.
3 hours of experience: The full version of the story takes about 3 hours to fast-forward, with a profound meaning contained in a concise story. The freely expandable and customizable music gameplay makes the game worth playing over and over again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984583/34a504e5175e7b58af3553f129b332b462ce6173.png[/img]
This is a game made out of love for music, based on classical and world music, delving into music theory and instruments, aspiring to become an encyclopedic music game.
If you love music, you cannot miss this game;
If you think music is dispensable, this game will make you fall in love with music;
If you hate music, you must experience this story to see what a world hostile to music would be like.

Please support us and give the game a good review. If you have any questions, please join our discord to get in touch with the developer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984583/ee00fe4219430a31bd656784f79a45b500065a63.png[/img]
To end with the last sentence of the game's finale:
I buried piece after piece of music, until one day, I too will be buried.
When I am buried, I hope it is music that buries me.

Elif Games

notes.title: Big Updates for Steam Next Fest: Try Out and Get Various Benefits
notes.content:
"Mound of Music" will participate in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, and we welcome everyone to check out latest game demo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984583/086a7a3044b76cc449c8abb122c6672d1e9aeed6.png[/img]

The significant updates include:

1. New Self-Compostion Feature: you can import your own music now.
[list]
[*] Find any track you like and prepare the pitch and timing points data.
[*] This feature is still in testing, if you encounter any issues, please join our discord for feedback any time.
[*] This content will be synchronized to the Steam Workshop upon the game's release.
[/list]
2. Music Gameplay Optimizations:
[list]
[*] Note styles can now be switched, in addition to the spherical style, two new styles have been added.
[*] You can choose whether to display background effects.
[*] You can adjust the speed of the notes separately or globally.
[*] Early and late prompts for notes have been added.
[/list]
3. Universal Music Box in Music Lab:
[list]
[*] Transform any text into music, regardless of the language.
[*] As the story progresses, you can choose NPCs to be the voice of the music box.
[*] All transformed music can be saved as a recording file.
[/list]
4. Optimized switching between story mode and music mode.
5. Fixed various bugs.

To show our gratitude for your support, we will be holding the following activities during Next Fest:

1. Players who try out the game and publish videos will receive a code for the full version of "Mound of Music".
2. Players who try out the demo and leave comments will receive a code for the official soundtrack of "Mound of Music".
3. The above activities are concurrent with the "Zhiyin Plan".
[url=https://elifgames.fun/contents/moundofmusic/240910_zhiyin_plan/zhiyin_plan.html]Zhiyin Plan Details[/url]

To ensure everything goes smoothly, please be sure to join our Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/SQ22XP4MKc]Join Discord[/url]
We wish you a happy Next Fest!

notes.title: August Version Update: New Music Exam
notes.content:
The full version of "Mound of Music" is nearing completion, with the following key features introduced:

1. The entire storyline has been completed, encompassing six chapters and 50 sections;
2. A new music exam system has been introduced, allowing players to bypass all narrative content and directly access all music gameplay by participating in the music exam;
3. A new "Devil's Deal" feature has been added, where players can trade their souls to the devil for assistance in the music gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984583/a2560f10c592409e4279cb59509f641d6cc6dd31.png[/img]

Apart from the complete narrative, the above-mentioned features are also available in the Demo version for you to try out!
The official release of the game is scheduled for the last quarter of this year. We appreciate your continued interest!

notes.title: Mound of Music: Demo Now Available for Play!
notes.content:
The “Mound of Music” DEMO is now available for download. We invite everyone to play and share your valuable feedback!

This DEMO offers a taste of most game features, including music gameplay, exploration, items, and the WIKI. About STORY, the full game encompasses six chapters, with the DEMO providing access to the overture and part of the first movement, representing approximately 10% of the complete story. About MUSIC, the full version promises at least 26 tracks, while the DEMO lets you experience all difficulties of 5 tracks. About EXPLORATION, the full game features 8 areas, and the DEMO version allows you to explore one of them.

The complete game is still in development and is slated for release in the fourth quarter of this year. We appreciate your continued support and encouragement!
